replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics is my foundation for understanding physics and economics. replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really. My high conscientiousness helps me stay focused on tasks without unnecessary worry. However, if a concept is unclear, I might feel some pressure to understand it quickly for my job, but anxiety isn't typical for me.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used AI tools occasionally to check my work or get alternative explanations. It was helpful for verifying calculations but didn't replace deep understanding. I prefer traditional methods for building core concepts.
